quest.title: Tabletop Adventurer
quest.description: Armand of Lepaute Horlogerie is in charge of taking care of their toys. Go see how you can try those gizmos out...

talks.objective: Talk to Armand, the staff member

dialogues.speaker: Armand
dialogues.text: H—H—Hello, you t—two... My name is... is... A—A—Armand...

dialogues.speaker: Armand
dialogues.text: S—S—Sorry! I—I get like th—this when th—there are too many... p—p—people around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No worries, no worries. You don't have to rush, we're just here to try out the toy!

dialogues.speaker: Armand
dialogues.text: O—Oh. S—S—Sure... I have p—prepared a... h—h—handbook for you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, that's so nice of you, Armand! We'll read it carefully for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Armand
dialogues.text: I—It's alright if you d—don't read it. It's very s—s—simple and f—fun... D—Do you want to t—try?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, I'll give it a go.
